{'text': 'Apple 進一步披露了今年 3 月公佈的 Apple Music 人工智能（AI）標註規定詳情。以下是具體內容。', 'source_text': "Apple has shared more details about its upcoming AI labeling rules for Apple Music, first announced in March. Here's what to know.", 'translate': False}

{'text': 'AI 生成的內容將會在 Apple Music 上面清楚標示', 'source_text': 'AI-generated content will be clearly labeled on Apple Music', 'translate': False}

{'text': 'Apple 較早前公佈，Apple Music 即將要求新加入平台的封面圖片、歌曲、作品和音樂影片申報 AI 透明資訊。', 'source_text': 'Apple previously announced that Apple Music would soon require new cover art, songs, tracks, and music videos submitted to the platform to disclose AI transparency information.', 'translate': False}

{'text': '現在這間公司進一步講解了相關的執行方式。', 'source_text': 'Now the company is offering further clarification on how it will be implemented.', 'translate': False}

{'text': 'Apple 今日發給創作者的電郵中提到：「今年稍後時間，我們亦會將這些標籤以『Made With AI』的形式展示給 Apple Music 用戶看。」', 'source_text': 'In an email to creators sent today, Apple said: "Later this year, we will also be surfacing these tags to listeners of Apple Music as Made With AI."', 'translate': False}

{'text': 'Apple 亦釐清了何時需要作出申報。電郵內容如下：', 'source_text': 'Apple also clarified when creators would need to disclose. The email reads:', 'translate': False}

{'text': 'Apple Music 補充說，這項措施的目標是「盡可能為聽眾提供最大透明度」，並且指引創作者參閱他們的《音樂風格指南》（Music Style Guide）以了解更多。', 'source_text': 'Apple Music added that the move is intended to "provide as much transparency to listeners as possible" and directed creators to its Music Style Guide for further information.', 'translate': False}

{'text': 'Apple Music 的做法只是串流平台如何應對 AI 生成音樂湧入的最新例子，皆因愈來愈多音樂人將生成式 AI 融入製作過程。', 'source_text': "Apple Music's move is just the latest example of streaming services grappling with an influx of AI-generated music, as more and more artists incorporate generative AI into their creative process.", 'translate': False}

{'text': 'Spotify 較早前表示，由 AI 角色創作的音樂預設上不會出現在編輯推薦和演算法推薦之中；Deezer 就於去年公佈，完全由 AI 生成的歌曲將會被排除於推薦和編輯歌單之外。Deezer 上個月亦公佈，完全由 AI 生成的音樂首次突破了每日新上傳歌曲的 50%。', 'source_text': 'Spotify previously said music created by AI personas would by default not appear in editorial recommendations and algorithmic recommendations, while Deezer announced last year that fully AI-generated songs would be excluded from recommendations and editorial playlists. Deezer also reported last month that fully AI-generated music had crossed 50% of daily new uploads for the first time.', 'translate': False}

{'text': '在 Apple Music 方面，平台主管 Oliver Schusser 較早前出席 Billboard 的 On the Record podcast，提到雖然每月上傳到 Apple Music 的音樂中有超過三分之一是完全由 AI 生成，但佔平台上的聆聽量不足 0.5%。', 'source_text': "For its part, Apple Music's head Oliver Schusser previously said on Billboard's On the Record podcast that while more than a third of music uploaded to Apple Music each month is fully AI-generated, it accounts for less than 0.5% of listens on the platform.", 'translate': False}

{'text': 'Apple Music 需要有效訂閱。每月費用 11.99 美元，首月免費，亦可以透過 Apple One 組合訂閱。', 'source_text': 'Apple Music requires a valid subscription. It costs $11.99 a month with a free first month, or it can be bundled with an Apple One subscription.', 'translate': False}
